newsitem.title: UK: Fairey buys NDC Systems of U.S. for $30 mln.
newsitem.headline: Fairey buys NDC Systems of U.S. for $30 mln.

text.p: British electronics and engineering firm Fairey Group Plc said on Tuesday it would buy NDC Systems of the U.S. for $30 million cash.
Fairey said the deal would add to earnings in 1997.

NDC, based in Irwindale, California, with sales and support in Europe and China, supplies gauging equipment used to measure density, thickness and other variables in the making of continuously extruded sheet materials.
Fairey said the deal would complement its existing process technology operations.
The company planned to pay for NDC from existing credit facilities, raising its total net debt to about 110 million stg.
Fairey's shares were flat at 485.5p at 0725 GMT.
